The emperor was so fascinated by her that her family gained enormous power and influence at the imperial court.

But then, in 755, a massive rebellion broke out.

The emperor and his court were forced to flee the capital.

As the empire fell into chaos, the soldiers blamed Yang Guifei and her powerful family for the disaster.

Then came the shocking moment.

The emperor’s own troops demanded that Yang Guifei be killed.

The emperor had no choice but to agree.

The woman who had once been the emperor’s greatest obsession became a symbol of the collapse of his golden age.

And her story is still remembered in China more than a thousand years later.
